newsitem.title: USA: Encore to sell business, settle debt.
newsitem.headline: Encore to sell business, settle debt.

text.p: Encore Computer Corp. said Wednesday it has a non-binding agreement to sell the assets, products and technology of its storage products business to Sun Microsystems Inc. for $185 million.
Encore, based in Fort Lauderdale, Fla., said it will use proceeds to cancel debt and outstanding convertible preferred stock held by Gould Electronics Inc.

Encore said the proceeds would be less than its debt to Gould and the liquidation preference of the preferred stock held by Gould. But the two companies are discussing a deal under which Gould would accept a "substantial" portion of the proceeds to satisfy the debt and most of the preferred stock, Encore said.
Encore provides data storage, retrieval and sharing technologies for mixed-platform processing environments.
Encore's stock edged up 6.3 cents to $1.75 on the Nasdaq bulletin board in late morning trading. Sun Microsystems fell 25 cents to $34 on Nasdaq.
